pages.text: Kifaru Bond Fund factsheet, issued by Nyota Asset Managers (SYN). Kifaru Bond Fund is a bond fund and its objective is to generate regular income from government and corporate bonds. The management fee of Kifaru Bond Fund is 1.9 percent per annum. The minimum initial investment in Kifaru Bond Fund is SYN Sh 1,000, and the minimum top-up is SYN Sh 1,000. Over the 12 months to 2026-09-30 Kifaru Bond Fund delivered an effective annual yield of 12.8 percent.

Withdrawals from Kifaru Bond Fund are paid within 2 business days. The main holdings of Kifaru Bond Fund are bank bonds (45 percent), Treasury bonds (40 percent) and corporate bonds (35 percent). Pwani Trustees (SYN) acts as trustee of Kifaru Bond Fund and holds its assets separately from the manager. Kifaru Bond Fund was launched in 2020 and is licensed by the SYN Capital Markets Authority. Past performance is not a guarantee of future results and the value of units can fall. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
